A FEW HELPFUL ANSWERS

Your questions.
A little more clarity.

Ask about this service
What can I see in the dashboard?+

The preview includes route timings, a bus journey simulation, attendance, an absence planner, fee records, downloadable receipts and sample alerts.

Is the map a real child’s location?+

No. It is a schematic simulation with invented family records. There is no live GPS connection or private student record in this front-end build.

Can I pay real fees here?+

The payment preview records a sample transaction on your device only. It does not collect financial details or transfer money.
